RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, December 3, 2014/Agrahayana 12, 1936 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce  and Industry; Culture; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Mines; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Steel; Tourism; Tribal
Affairs; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
Para-military officers taken on
deputation in NIA
*141. SHRI DIGVIJAYA SINGH: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to refer to answer to Starred
Question 227 given in the Rajya Sabha on
the 23rd July, 2014 and  state:
(a) how many officers from Para-
military forces, above the rank of Deputy
Superintendant of Police, from a non-
investigative background have been taken
on deputation in the National Investigation
Agency (NIA); and
(b) the reason/logic behind taking
officers from non-investigating experience
to man investigative agencies like NIA?
Damage to Odisha due to Hudhud
cyclone
*142. SHRI RANJIB BISWAL: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has assessed
the damage, in terms of loss of life, property
and crops, caused to the State of Odisha
due to Hudhud cyclone, if so, the details
thereof;
(b) whether the State Government of
Odisha has requested the Central
Government for adequate Central
assistance, if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the quantum of Central assistance
given by Government to the State in this
regard?
Targets for 'Make in India' campaign
*143. SHRI K.N. BALAGOPAL: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has started
'Make in India' campaign;
(b) if so, the aims and targets thereof;
and
(c) whether any priority or special
schemes are being formulated for promoting
India made products over imported ones,
if so, the details thereof?

44
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Import price of crude oil vis-a-vis
retail selling price
*144. SHRI ARVIND KUMAR
SINGH: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the import price of crude
oil is around ` 30/- per litre at present;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
the details of refining and transportation
cost of petrol per litre at present in the
country;
(c) the reasons for higher rate of retail
selling price of petrol and diesel by oil
companies; and
(d) whether Government would reduce
the retail selling price as per the import
price and other costs like refining and
transportation, if so, the details thereof?
Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Shramev
Jayate Karyakram
*145. SHRI RANGASAYEE
RAMAKRISHNA: Will the Minister of
LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the Pandit Deendayal
Upadhyay Shramev Jayate Karyakram
recently announced; and
(b) in what manner this programme will
improve the ease of doing business which
is essential to ensure the success of the
'Make in India' campaign?
Meeting shortage of manpower in the
world  by 2020 with Indian labour
force
*146. SHRI HUSAIN DALWAI: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Boston Consultancy
Group's study had indicated that by 2020
while India will have surplus of 56 million
working people, the rest of the world will
encounter a shortage of 47 million working
people;
(b) if so, the strategy chalked out by
Government to exploit this situation; and
(c) the details of the progress made so
far?
Law to protect interests of domestic
workers
†*147. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the number
of domestic workers is around five crores
throughout the country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that there is
still no law to protect the interests of
domestic workers;
(c) whether a memorandum signed by
thousands of domestic workers has also
been given to the Prime Minister by the
'National Platform for Domestic Workers';
and
(d) if so, by when Government would
enact law to protect the interests of
domestic workers, and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Visa-on-Arrival facility to
Indian nationals
*148. SHRIMATI JAYA
BACHCHAN: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has taken note
of the Visa-on-Arrival facility being
provided by various countries to citizens
of selected countries;

45
(b) how many countries provide such
facility to Indian nationals, the details
thereof;
(c) whether Government has taken any
initiative to increase the number of countries
providing Visa-on-Arrival to Indian
nationals; and
(d) if so, the details thereof, and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Fast by Irom Chanu Sharmila for

(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the 15 year old fast by Irom
Chanu Sharmila demanding withdrawal of
the Armed Forces Special Powers Act
(AFSPA) from Manipur; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reacti

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, December 3, 2014/Agrahayana 12, 1936 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Commerce and Industry; Culture; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Mines; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Steel; Tourism; Tribal
Affairs; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 155
Promotion of industrial activity
1086. SHRI D. KUPENDRA REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of steps taken by
Government during the last ten years for
the promotion of industrial activity in the
country to make India a manufacturing hub
in various sectors like automobiles, textiles,
pharmaceuticals, food processing, etc.;
(b) the sectors which were identified
for the purpose and the number of new
cities decided to be developed as investment
centres; and
(c) the details of the changes
contemplated in the existing schemes under
the new 'Make in India' programme
launched by the Prime Minister recently?
  Intangible Cultural Heritage tag
1087. SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR: Will the Minister
of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has issued
directives to all States to prepare a list of
cultural practices which could be submitted
for nominations for inscription in the
‘Representative List of Intangible Cultural
Heritage’;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the list of rituals/festivities/practices
from Karnataka that were enlisted to seek
UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage
(ICH) tag;
(d) the steps Government proposes to
procure ICH tag to those enlisted; and
(e) the other monuments in Karnataka
that are pending with Government to seek
UNESCO's world heritage site tag?
  Setting up of Vizag-Chennai
Industrial Corridor
1088. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government has
initiated any action on setting up of Vizag-
Chennai Industrial Corridor along the lines
of Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor and
other issues as provided in the Andhra
Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 and also
as was assured by the then Prime Minister
on the floor of the Rajya Sabha on 20th
February, 2014 during the passage of the
Bill; and

243
(b) if so, the details thereof?
  Review of functioning of SEZs
1089. DR. K.V.P . RAMACHANDRA
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
review the functioning and performance of
Special Economic Zones (SEZs) in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the review done so far in this regard;
and
(d) the steps taken to improve the
functioning of SEZs?
  India's stand in the WTO
Ministerial Conference
1090. DR. BHALCHANDRA
MUNGEKAR: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the stand the Ministry has taken in
the recently held World Trade Organization
(WTO) Ministerial Conference with
respect to the Treaty on Agriculture;
(b) the status of the 'peace clause';
(c) whether it has been lapsed or
indefinitely postponed; and
(d) the impact of (b) and (c) above on
India's food security?
  Steps to help rubber cultivators in
Kerala
1091. SHRI M.P. ACHUTHAN: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the plight of rubber cultivators
in Kerala due to the fall in the prices of
natural rubber recently;
(b) if so, the details of the variation in
prices of rubber during the last two years,
the current per kg. price and the estimated
remunerative price of rubber;
(c) whether it is a fact that the faulty
import policy of rubber has been the main
reason for the fall in indigenous prices of
rubber; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
measures being taken to help the rubber
cultivators in Kerala?
  Reduction in allocation of funds
under ASIDE to Tamil Nadu
1092. DR. R. LAKSHMANAN: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether funds released to State of
Tamil Nadu under the Assistance to States
for Infrastructure Development of Exports
(ASIDE) has been reduced from 
` 67.27
crores in 2011-12 to ` 60.66 crores in
2013-2014; and
(b) if so, the reasons for reduction in
allocation of funds under this scheme?
  Joint official Panel to sort out trade
related issues with China
1093. SHRI PRAMOD TIWARI:
SHRI K.C. TY AGI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India and China have set up
a joint official Panel to sort out trade related
issues;
(b) if so, the composition of members
of the Panel and whether the Panel has since
discussed the trade related disputes;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the details of trade related issues

244
under consultation with China and the
manner in which those issues are likely to
be sorted out?
  Trade Policy Forum to discuss trade
issues with US

Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleas
